messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: PROD - model-catalog: published_revision_mismatch fired for service=model-catalog (severity: P1). Trigger: config promotion detected a tokenizer mismatch between model revision `rev-2026-02-11` and default runtime tokenizer. Details: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: Incident paged to on-call Aisha. Escalation will occur in 5m if unacked.

Aisha: acked the page. I'm on it — taking lead. Can someone pull the catalog change diff?

Luca: I'm pulling diffs now. Looks like the promotion job auto-swapped default to rev-2026-02-11 for model t5-redwood-v1 with tokenizer `tokenizer-v2` but runtime expects `tokenizer-v1`.

Priya: seeing increased 500s on inference logs for customers on region us-west-2, likely tokenization errors. Example log snippet below:

Priya: ```
ERROR inference: tokenizer mismatch for model t5-redwood-v1 rev-2026-02-11: expected token id mapping not found at index 12
Traceback: TokenizerError -> decode()
```

Jonah: paging question — do we want to rollback the catalog promotion or hotpatch the runtime tokenizer mapping? Rollback is faster.

Aisha: rollback first. Prioritize minimizing customer impact. Steps: 1) disable auto-promo job, 2) pin default revision to previous stable rev (rev-2026-01-28), 3) trigger canary redeploy for affected routes. I'll coordinate.

Aisha: disabling auto-promotion: `/infra/jenkins disable-job catalog-auto-promote` (done).

Luca: pinning default via admin API:

Luca: ```bash
curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/v1/models/t5-redwood-v1/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"revision":"rev-2026-01-28","reason":"emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch"}'
```

Luca: API returned 200. Default revision pinned to rev-2026-01-28.

SupportBot: Notifying affected customers list (tenant ids): tenant-349, tenant-662, tenant-998. Creating support tickets.

Priya: after pin, I'm seeing error rate drop on canary nodes. Latency back to baseline for most routes. Still seeing ~2% errors for tenant-662, digging logs.

Jonah: I'm going to apply temporary routing rule to send traffic for model t5-redwood-v1 in us-west-2 to fallback model t5-redwood-v0 for high-priority customers until we confirm stability. Command: `rbx route set --model t5-redwood-v1 --fallback t5-redwood-v0 --region us-west-2 --tenants tenant-662,tenant-349`

Aisha: good call. Apply and monitor. Also postmortem checklist: record timeline, root cause (promotion job not validating tokenizer compatibility), mitigation (disable job + pin), next steps (add pre-promo validation).

Luca: quick note — logs show one customer (tenant-998) using a custom tokenizer override; we need to contact solutions to confirm they don't rely on rev-2026-02-11 specifics. @Jonah can you loop in Customer Success?

Jonah: looping in CS via email thread and created ticket CS-8347. Support assigned to Priya to coordinate with tenant-998.

Aisha: escalation state: I'm keeping the incident open for 45m for monitoring then will handoff to Luca for postmortem. Who's taking postmortem write-up?

Luca: I'll draft the postmortem. Will include sequence, diff snippets, monitoring graphs, and mitigation script.

Priya: customer-impact summary for initial incident report: ~12 tenants saw transient request failures, two had increased latency >2x for ~20 minutes, no data leak. Support tickets created.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: acknowledged by Aisha. Current state: active -> mitigation in progress.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Aisha. Escalation stopped.

SupportBot: tenant-349 and tenant-662 notified via email and in-app banner. Tenant-998 on-call contact paged for verification.

Aisha: preparing handoff to Luca in 30m. Last checks: confirm monitoring shows error rate <0.5% for 15m and rollback remains stable.

Luca: confirmed: error rate 0.2% over last 10m, canary healthy, no new promotions queued. I'll take postmortem and follow up with next steps (add tokenizer compatibility check in CI, add metric alert for tokenizer mismatch patterns).

Aisha: thanks team. Closing active mitigation in 30m unless something regresses. Leaving incident channel open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
